translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen Eyor Aniu Aenneew Wooan
Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra toori noa epeig meoneoiniuniun Galilee noan faniuwaen Gerasa.
E teeotiw rhag Jesus me wooan pwoot we, nge erhai mwaaen a itto reen nge etowow me noan paeyi kkewe. Mwaaen een eno erhai aniu aenneew wooan,
nge e nonno rhag weni niipw. Esooar erhai ne emmwenen feoti ngaeni ccheen;

faaen fitowu mwo aar geoni paiun me pirheen, nge esooaw feffereei noa rhag, iwe me egaen ripiy parang we ammwarhiun ngaeni pirheen. Mwaaen een e igin mamaaw iwe esooar erhai ne epwe mmwenen ammwarhiu.
Nee pwoong me nee raaen aan mwetefetaen rhag neeiin paeyi kkewe me weei rhug, aan gaen iyaekkepwas me wunei oanongan ngaeni faai.
E rhiuwen taaw noa nge a weri Jesus, nge a fattapw ngaeni, nge a foat pwiugiuwtiw me weni mmwan,
nge a aekkepwas temoag tae, “Jesus, Naiun Deus iwe e oarosaen Taegias! Meeta minne wo tipaeni me reei? Iya tingoar ngaeniug mmwaen mesaen Deus pwe wosoapw aewwaeiraesiaei.”
(E iura kkepas een pwe igiwe Jesus a faer kkepas ngaeni pwe, “Aniu aenneew, toowow me reen mwaaen na!”)
Iwe, Jesus a aeiineow pwe, “Meeta itoamw?” Mwaaen we a paniuwaeni pwe, “Itaei nge Cchon, pwe aemaem aei igin towunap!”
Nge aniu aenneew we e tingoar maaw ngaeni rhag Jesus pwe esoapw asiiur wow me noan faniuw we.
Eyor eew cchon sino arapeto pwiuneoi we re mwongo wooan rhoangorhoang we.
Iwe aniu aenneew kkewe ra aeffaenipirhe ngaeni Jesus pwe, “Fangenoa aemaem neeiir sino kenaan, wa fang ngaenigemaem pwe aeipwe wartae wooar.”

Jesus a fangenoa iir, nge aniu aenneew kkewe ra toowow saengi mwaaen we nge ra noa wartae wooar sino kkewe. Oanongaen cchon sino kkewe, iwe re aerepa riiungeras ra fattapw tiw me wenepeigin rhug we ittiw noan meoneoiniun we nge remoapw noa.
Mwaaen kkewe rhooan ffooanon sino ra fattapw noa nge ra noa oaronga fetaeneei miniwe ewen noan aepinoamw we me menaai kkewe. Aeremas ra noa ngaeni neniy we pwe repwe noa pipiiy miniwe a wen,
nge igiwe ra itto reen Jesus, ra giuneei mwaaen we eyor cchon aniu aenneew wooan. A mooat igiwe nge e memmengaag, nge iiy man reepiy, iwe oanongeer ra maegin mesag.
Iwe rhooawe reweri meeta we ewen ra fioangei ngaeniir aeremas meeta we a wen ngaeni mwaaen we eyor aniu aenneew wooan me sino kkewe.
Iwe ra tingoar ngaeni Jesus pwe epwe siusaengi miniwe faniuweer.
Nge igiwe Jesus a teeotae wooan pwoot we, mwaaen we eyor aniu aenneew wooan a tingoar ngaeni pwe, “Emmwen pwe ipwe tapweog?”
Nge Jesus ese mwerhaen. A aengaeni pwe, “Sefaaen noa noan imwoamw reen oamw famini nge wa fioangei ngaeniir minikka Soamwoon a feeori ngaeniug, iwe me aan igin gacch ngaeniug.”
Iwe mwaaen we a siusaengi, a noa noan oanongaen miniwe Seig Aepinoamw, a noa aepesa miniwe Jesus a feeori ngaeni. Oanongeer rhooa kkewe re rongorong nge ra igin riutae.
Naiun Jairus Rhooapwut me Rhooapwut we e Geotteopa Mengaagiun Jesus
Jesus a sefaaen noa epeig nooamw we. Reen ngaerhen meoneoiniun we nge regin towunap aeremas kka ra mwirhito reen.
Jairus, erhai soamwoonin noan wutteer Jews we a itto, nge igiwe a weri Jesus, a aesirowu tiw me oaron pirheen
nge a tingoar aeffaenipirhe ngaeni pwe, “Aeterhooapwut mwittig na naeyi a igin cchoaw aan semwaai. Faaen pirhemw itto wopwe iseni tae poawumw wooan pwe epwe takketae me epwe menaw!”
Iwe Jesus a tapweei noa mwaaen we. Re igin towunap aeremas kka ra tapweei noa Jesus ra aetietiy ngaeni oanongaen wenepeigin.
Eno erhai rhooapwut neeiir eseiug aan peitaeg noa noan seig me ruwowu raeg,
inamwo igiwe a sefaaen me reer towunepeer toagota. A pwan naini oanongaen naiun senaapiy, nge faer egius mwo nge efaer kkaein noa.
Oatowe rhooapwut we a rongorong wunuunun kkepesaen Jesus, a itto me niugiusagiuriun neeiin pinowun aeremas kkewe,
nge a maengiy noan tipan pwe, “Aere i geotteopa rhag mengaagiun, nge ipwe mamaaw tae.”
Reen rhag oatowe e geotteopa mengaagiun, nge semwaai we aan a iug noa, nge a meyaefi wooan oanongan pwe a rhigar saengi waeiraes we aan.
Iwe rhag nge Jesus a meyaefi pwe eew kkeman a toowow saengi, iwe a toagun ngaeniir aeremas kkewe nge a aeiineeor pwe, “Iyo we a geotteopa mengaagiuy?”
Rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Woweriir aeremas kka re aetietiy ngaeniug rhag, nge meeta wa aeiineo iyo we a geotteopoag reen?”
Nge Jesus a fanefetaen pwe epwe giuneei iyo we a feeori miniwe.
Nge igiwe rhooapwut we a giuneei meeta we a wen ngaeni, a ngongotae reen aan mesag, iwe a itto foatotiw me oaron pirheen iwe a pwaeri ngaeni weneccheran meeta we a wen ngaeni.
Iwe Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Naeyi, oamw niugiuniug minne a aecchipwoag tae. Wonoa noan oapoas pwe wa rhigar saengi oamw waeiraes.”

Nge igiwe Jesus e rhiuwen kekkepas, aaemweoi rhooan pweipwogin kkepas ra itto me reen imwaen Jairus ra aengaeni pwe, “A mae noa rhooapwut we noawumw. E rhiuwen meeta ipitaen oamw itiwow angiurhiu no ngaeni sinsei na?”
Nge Jesus ese aefaenniy meeta we re aepesa, nge a aengaeni Jairus pwe, “Wote mesag, niugiuniug rhag.”
Jesus esa tipaeni no nge erhai epwe tapweei, pwe aaen Peter rhag me James me John iwe pwiin.
Igiwe ra tooto reen imwaen Jairus, Jesus a giuneei aar pwurhopwurh fetaen me rongorong aar oacchorong me ngiuraegin aar saeng.
Iwe a toonong noan iimw we a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta oawwa pwurhopwurh fetaen reen? Meeta oawwa saeng reen? Aeteen nge ese mae, pwe aan rhag maiur.”

Iwe ra kekkaei aegini, iwe a asiiur wow oanongeer me noan iimw we, nge a paeniir seman me inaen aeterhooapwut we, me eoniurhai naiun rhooan kkayeo, iwe a paeniir nong noan sengkin we aeterhooapwut we ewon ee.
A ammwarhiu tae paiun nge a aengaeni pwe, “Talitha koum!” faaen minneen nge, “Aeterhooapwut, i aengaeniug wopwe rhimwitae!”
E iutae rhag nge a faaeraeg fetaen. (Iya seig me ruwowu raegin.) Nge igiwe a wen miniwe oanongaen aeremas kkewe ra igin riutae.
Nge Jesus a aetiwenigiy ngaeniir pwe resoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai, nge a pwan aengaeniir pwe, “Oaw ngaenneei meeta epwe angi”.
